research_rationale:
Identity: the held Federal Register text (28 FR 3909) prints Executive Order 11105 as an order of the President (John F. Kennedy) dated 1963-04-18; the number, subject and date agree with the census register row (subject: Transferring to the Housing and Home Finance Administrator certain functions of the Atomic Energy Commission under the Atomic Energy Community Act of 1955). I read the whole text and signature block. Inventory: the dossier's seven clauses are contiguous and together cover every operative sentence from Section 1 through the quoted new section added to Executive Order 10657. Their labels do not always match the order's own section numbers (the first clause holds Section 1 and the opening of Section 2; the clause labelled sec3 holds Sections 3, 4 and 5; the clause labelled sec7 holds Sections 7 and 8 and the opening of Section 9; the clause labelled sec8 is the quoted new Section 8 of Executive Order 10657 inserted by Section 9). I confirm the inventory as complete and decide each clause separately. The order, issued under the Atomic Energy Community Act of 1955 (the Act), makes Sections 2 to 8 applicable to the community of Los Alamos, New Mexico (and not to Oak Ridge or Richland); transfers specified Atomic Energy Commission functions under the Act to the Housing and Home Finance Administrator, with two groups of functions retained by the Commission; transfers to the Administrator the interests, rights and powers of the United States in property designated by the Commission for disposal under Section 52 of the Act, effective parcel by parcel when the Administrator executes a deed or a contract to purchase; gives the Administrator ancillary powers and the proceeds of disposals; requires consultation between the two agencies; amends Executive Order No. 9816 to the extent inconsistent; preserves prior Commission actions and obligations; and adds a new Section 8 to Executive Order No. 10657 excluding Los Alamos from that order. Ending: EO 12553 of February 25, 1986, titled "Revocation of Various Executive Orders", orders that the listed Executive Orders, and "any amendments thereto, are revoked:" Its table lists this order by number and subject on one line: "11105 Transferring to the Housing and Home Finance Administrator certain functions of the Atomic Energy". EO 12553 contains no effective-date wording (the held text was searched for effective, take effect, shall become, except, notwithstanding, nothing in, provided that and saving, with no hit outside table subjects); it is headed as an order of February 25, 1986 and signed that day, so the date is read as 1986-02-25, the signing date. The alternative reading is the Federal Register publication date, 1986-03-03 (Monday, March 3, 1986, 51 FR 7237); no later date is supported by the text. The packet holds no located acting-provision record for this pair (the dossier lists the target provision as not located), so the end is cited to the complete held text of EO 12553 (Federal Register copy, 51 FR 7237), which contains both the enacting paragraph and the table row quoted above; I read the whole text and the row is present on its own line. The ACT-type record in the dossier for this pair points at the page-11 number column of EO 12553, where the held OCR separates the numbers from their subjects; I do not rely on it, and rely instead on the row on the page where each row's number and subject appear on one line, quoted above. Section 4 makes the property transfers effective parcel by parcel on execution of a deed or purchase contract; no held source shows when or whether every parcel was disposed of, so that performance-based sequence is not claimed as an end and is disclosed. No held source shows that any statute or order other than EO 12553 extinguished these transfers; later reorganizations of the agencies named are not held sources and are not claimed. Savings: EO 12553 has no savings clause or exception; Section 8 of the order itself preserves prior Commission actions and outstanding obligations, and deeds or contracts already executed under Section 4 are accrued consequences. Searches selected after reading their coverage notes (all three complete, no coverage warning): U.S. Code release point 119-121 (no hit for this order), eCFR as of 2026-10-14 (no hit), and the Federal Register catalog disposition notes (2 machine hits, the revocation note on this order and the matching note on EO 12553).

savings.reason: The order's own Section 8 preserves actions taken and obligations outstanding before the order's effective date, and EO 12553 contains no savings clause or exception; transfers already executed by deed or contract under Section 4 before 1986-02-25 are accrued consequences. No continuing independent command was found in the full text of EO 12553, the U.S. Code, eCFR or the Federal Register catalog notes.
